mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS <= 1.5% is negative or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5%, the average 5-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, the average 60-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle slowdown regime (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle slowdown regime (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually), the average 20-day forward return when INDPRO declines is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL growth rate) below 2.0% signals stable price dynamics that reduces the probability of aggressive monetary tightening, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when CPIAUCSL growth rate < 2.0% is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,200,000 units (1200.0 in series units) signals robust housing market strength that boosts consumer confidence and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200.0, the average 5-day forward return is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, the average 60-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.
